acp_agent_id.description: Run fires through this ACP agent (id from list_acp_agents). Only for fresh sessions.

acp_model_id.description: ACP agent model id (from list_acp_agents with agent_id). Requires acp_agent_id or an ACP session_id.

max_calls.description: Optional max calls, null means unlimited

model_id.description: Native model override: a model_uuid from list_models. Not valid together with acp_agent_id/acp_model_id.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort override (native: none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max as supported by the model; ACP: the agent's effort ids).

session_id.description: Run every fire in this existing session instead of a fresh one. The session's runtime and workdir are inherited.

workdir_id.description: Bind fresh sessions to this workdir (id from list_workdirs).
